description.p: You’ve developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling, and you can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you: make another grapple check, and if you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

sheet.description: Advantage on attacks against a creature you are grappling; you can use your action to try to pin a grappled creature (both restrained).
